description: Source code for Google Text Moderation integration within a larger project, defining a class that uses Google Cloud's Natural Language API to moderate text content asynchronously.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_GoogleTextModeration
classes.description: A class that performs text moderation using Google Cloud's Natural Language API, with configurable confidence thresholds for various content categories.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the moderation client, loads Google Cloud language library, and sets confidence thresholds for categories.

methods.name: print_verbose
methods.description: Logs verbose debug information and optionally prints it if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Asynchronously processes messages, calls Google's moderation API, and raises exceptions if content violates safety thresholds.
